en.headline: Rumsey Street car park floors to close for Interpol assembly
en.dek: Police will take over the seventh and eighth floors of the Sheung Wan public car park from 1 November as a traffic command centre for the 94th Interpol General Assembly.
body: Hong Kong police said the seventh and eighth floors of the Rumsey Street Multi-storey Car Park in Sheung Wan will be used as a traffic coordination command centre from 1 November, then reopen to the public on 12 December after the 94th Interpol General Assembly.

The force set out the plan in a paper for the Central and Western District Council. Police said the two floors would accommodate 240 electric cars used to ferry participants between the airport, hotels and meeting venues. The assembly is scheduled for 30 November to 3 December at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, the first time Hong Kong has hosted Interpol’s top governing body.

Police said the government car park was chosen because it is on Hong Kong Island and close to official hotels and the meeting venue, which they said would help with coordinating and dispatching vehicles. The force said it would watch traffic around the car park and take measures if needed to keep nearby roads moving.

zh.headline: 林士街停車場兩層將關閉 供國際刑警大會調度車輛
zh.dek: 警方將於11月1日起徵用上環林士街多層停車場7樓及8樓作交通指揮中心，大會後12月12日重開。
body: 警務處表示，上環林士街多層停車場7樓及8樓由11月1日起會用作交通統籌指揮中心，第94屆國際刑警組織全體大會結束後，將於12月12日重新開放予公眾使用。
警方在提交中西區區議會的文件中交代安排。警方指，該兩層將停泊240輛電動車，接載與會人士往返機場、酒店及會議場地。大會訂於11月30日至12月3日在灣仔香港會議展覽中心舉行，是香港首次主辦國際刑警最高決策機構會議。
警方表示，林士街停車場屬政府公眾停車場，位置鄰近官方酒店及會議場地，有利統籌及調度車輛。警方會密切留意停車場外交通，必要時採取措施，確保附近道路暢順。
